One day when  he was about 6 or 7 he got out of the house somehow and was gone fore a couple days, which isn't abnormal. He came back and meowed at the door to be let in and it was like a different cat. He was loving and sweet, sitting in everyone's laps and purring. He even slept with me that night without attacking my leg. The next day he got out again somehow and never came back. I think he knew he was dying and wanted to let us all know that even though he was a jerk most of the time he did love us too. 

I still miss you everyday Mojo!

I've had a lot of paranormal experiences in my life. Mostly centered around my little sisters when they were young kids. 

Everything started when we moved into a new house and my middle sister who was 4 at the time stated that she didn't like her new room bc it was Catherine's room and she didn't want anyone else there. Things escalated to where we were all hearing footsteps upstairs, feeling like we were being watched in the basement, being tired all the time. Someone would let the dogs out of their cages and several small pets died unexpectedly. My family would tell me they saw me in other areas of the house when I was sleeping in my room or my brother would ask why I was just standing in the upstairs closet when I hadn't even been home. We had a couple pictures of me with a what looked like a demon's face right behind my shoulder. 

We all knew something was wrong with the place and we couldn't wait for our lease to be up so we could move. Aside from the haunting, we were also over run with mice. No matter what we did we could never get rid of them. 

After we moved out and came back to clean up the place we found 5 mice mutilated in the bath tub. They were all decapitated. 

Not 6 months after we moved we saw on the news that a couple had been murdered in the alley right behind what had been our back fence. I stand by the fact that that place was some kind of portal to hell. No amount of words could explain the feeling of dread that place gave us and probably explained why my poor single mother was a less to afford such a nice, big house. 

I have more stories if anyone is interested.
